title: Phaedra: Learning High-Fidelity Discrete Tokenization for the Physical Science
abstract: arXiv:2602.03915v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tokens are discrete representations that allow modern deep learning to scale by transforming high-dimensional data into sequences that can be efficiently learned, generated, and generalized to new tasks. While foundational for image and video generation, the application of tokens to physical simulation remains nascent. Because existing tokenizers are designed for the perceptual requirements of natural images, they struggle with scientific data, which exhibits large dynamic ranges and requires exact preservation of physical and spectral properties. translated_title: Phaedra：面向物理科学的高保真离散分词学习
translated_abstract: Token（词元）是一种离散表示，它通过将高维数据转换为可被高效学习、生成并泛化到新任务的序列，使现代深度学习得以扩展。尽管 token 是图像和视频生成的基石，但其在物理仿真中的应用仍处于起步阶段。由于现有的分词器是为自然图像的感知需求而设计的，它们难以处理科学数据——这类数据具有很大的动态范围，并要求精确保持物理和光谱属性。在这项工作中，我们研究了一系列图像分词器在专门用于衡量 PDE（偏微分方程）保真度的指标上的表现。观察到这些基线方法难以同时捕捉精细的几何细节和精确的物理量值，我们提出了 Phaedra——一种受经典形状-增益量化以及基函数与连续…范式启发的新型分词器（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Phaedra——一种受形状-增益量化与基函数范式启发的新型离散分词器，能够同时保留科学数据中的精细几何细节与精确物理量值，为物理仿真提供高保真的离散表示。
en_tdlr: Phaedra is a novel discrete tokenizer, inspired by classical shape-gain quantization and basis-function paradigms, that enables high-fidelity tokenization of scientific data by simultaneously preserving fine geometric details and precise physical magnitudes for physical simulation.
